name: streaming
title: Streaming
purpose: The note that the agent is still producing output: a small turning mark and words that say what is happening.
whenToUse: As the last row of a transcript while a turn runs.
Beside a task's title or its Stop control, to say that work is still going on.
whenNotToUse: On a button whose action is running. Set aria-busy on the button, which draws its own mark.
For progress with a known amount done. Use a progress element.
To say that a turn has ended. Use a message of the turn-end kind.

variants.name: default
variants.use: A line of muted text with the mark before it, anywhere in a view.

variants.name: row
variants.use: On the last li of a transcript. It takes the padding of a message row, so the words line up with the labels above.

accessibility: Always write the words. The mark is drawn by the stylesheet and is not announced.

Put role="status" on the element that holds the words, so a screen reader announces them when they change. Keep that element in the page before the words change, and remove the indicator when the work ends.

Change the words only when the state changes, such as from working to stopping. Put figures that tick, such as elapsed time, in gw-streaming__detail outside the role="status" element, so they are not announced every second.
Under prefers-reduced-motion the mark stops turning and the words remain.
It holds no control and takes no focus. The app adds it when a turn starts and removes it when the turn ends.
